title: Portugal's most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Portugal in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Rui Costa: Rui Costa and Bruno Fernandes are joint 10th with 94; either fills the 10th place.
notes.Bruno Fernandes: Bruno Fernandes and Rui Costa are joint 10th with 94 (Bruno's caps since 19 July 2026 don't count); either fills the 10th place.
notes.Cristiano Ronaldo: Cristiano Ronaldo had 233 at the end of the 2026 World Cup.

sources: Transfermarkt match reports for Portugal's nine games from March to July 2026 (https://www.transfermarkt.com/portugal/spielplan/verein/3300/saison_id/2026)
checks: RSSSF (to 16 November 2025) plus Portugal's 2026 games up to the World Cup final, checked against Wikipedia's records page (to 27 September 2026, minus the September games: Ronaldo 234 less 1, Bernardo Silva 114 less 1, Bruno Fernandes 95 less 1) and against national-football-teams.com's year pages counted from 2000 (FIFA and non-FIFA games together, as the FPF counts them). Portugal's 2026 games up to the World Cup final (nine, the last the quarter-final against Spain on 6 July) come from national-football-teams.com and Transfermarkt match reports, which agree player by player: Ronaldo 7 games and 3 goals, Bruno Fernandes 9 and 1, Bernardo Silva 6, Ruben Dias 6, Joao Cancelo 9, Joao Felix 7 and 1. The September and October 2026 games are left out. Ronaldo 226 + 7 = 233, Bernardo Silva 107 + 6 = 113, Bruno Fernandes 85 + 9 = 94. Transfermarkt counts a few more for current players (it includes autumn 2026 and some extra games) and has Bruno Alves on 95; RSSSF, Wikipedia and national-football-teams.com all have 96. Rui Costa and Bruno Fernandes share 10th on 94, so the 10th place is a pool.
